column1: # CHANNELS.tsv -- which TAG each published channel currently points at. Append-only.
# THE CHANNEL IS A POINTER, NOT A VERSION SUFFIX, and that is forced rather than chosen:
# Archipelago calls tuplize_version() on archipelago.json's world_version when it loads an apworld,
# and that raises on any prerelease form ('0.3.8-beta.1' -> ValueError). A suffix is a load-time
# crash, not a label. So every build keeps a strict X.Y.Z and a tag, and a channel names one.
# Promotion is a new ROW, never an edit: "when did stable last move, and to what" is a question
# somebody will ask after a bad release, and an overwritten cell cannot answer it.
# Measured cadence 2026-08-08 over 30 tags (v0.1 .. v0.3.7, 34 days): MEDIAN GAP 0.82 DAYS.
# Daily is not an aspiration here, it is what already happens -- which is why stable can be the
# newest tag rather than a slow-moving one, and why the skew this file exists to bound is ~1 day.
# Website label: `beta -> main` is the Development channel. CI publishes that moving pointer as
# the GitHub prerelease tag `dev`; stable continues to name an immutable vX.Y.Z tag from this ledger.
